task_type: full-stack product implementation and production release
requested_outcome: Implement all 19 approved public-site, administration, reporting and QQQAAA requirements without regressing the approved design, publish one complete candidate, and verify the exact public release.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co and its authenticated administration system
authorization_boundary: Code, data-mapping, tests and public publication are authorized by Adir. No real booking, lead, review, call, WhatsApp message, purchase, destructive data action, AWS resumption or domain cutover is authorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: The work changes VII-specific business pages, units, galleries, contacts, reports and QQQAAA.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Apply VII_PLATFORM_MASTER_PLAN and VII_FEEDBACK_STANDARD as product truth and test the full affected VII family.

lesson_bundle.reason: Adir requested end-to-end completion and public verification.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Map every one of the 19 requirements to exact public or operational evidence and block completion on any unverified item.

lesson_bundle.reason: The task explicitly authorizes production publication.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Freeze an exact candidate, preserve rollback identity, publish once, and verify the exact live version and critical routes.

lesson_bundle.reason: Biz totals, progress counters, unit inventory and availability are visible metrics.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Define source, formula, scope, period and reconciliation evidence for each changed metric.

lesson_bundle.reason: The operational admin, reports and QA console are core deliverables.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify loading, empty, success, failure, permissions, persistence, reload and natural operational reflection.

lesson_bundle.reason: The task changes buttons, sortable headers, floating actions and multiple visible controls.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Exercise every changed control and expand a shared-component defect to the full family.

lesson_bundle.reason: Equivalent components span all VII worlds and viewports.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Keep structure and behavior aligned across worlds, desktop and mobile with documented exceptions only.

lesson_bundle.reason: Adir explicitly required that nothing else in the approved design be damaged.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Record invariants before edits and reject any unrelated visual, copy, data or behavior change.

predicted_rejections.rejection: One screenshot example is fixed while the same shared component remains broken in another world or viewport.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inventory all public and admin families that use each changed component and run family-wide regression.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop and 390px evidence across vacations, events, hourly, spa, attractions and suppliers plus admin representatives.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Biz and availability numbers look polished but still disagree with the authoritative API or between panels.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Trace the data pipeline, pagination, filters, deduplication and cache keys before changing display code.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Reconciliation fixtures and production reads show one run identity and explain every displayed total.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The release damages an approved layout, contact action, gallery or mobile state outside the requested delta.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Freeze invariants and compare the complete affected family before and after.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Targeted-change regression evidence records unchanged hierarchy, content and behavior outside the delta.

predicted_rejections.rejection: QQQAAA still exposes technical codes without telling an operator what was checked and what to do.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add a plain-Hebrew presentation layer while retaining expandable professional evidence.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Live admin run shows level, progress, current check, simple explanation, impact, action and professional details.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Code and local tests pass but the public version does not contain the changes or has a new runtime failure.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Publish the frozen tested artifact only and run post-deploy route, interaction, data and responsive checks.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Exact public version, deployment identity, direct URLs, screenshots and rollback are recorded.

sources.label: VII product decisions and current truth
Accepted VII page, contact, gallery, mobile and QQQAAA behavior

midpoint_gate.trigger: After tracing the data contracts and completing one representative vacation detail, one admin report and one QQQAAA event slice before expanding shared components.
checks: Representative unit inventory and gallery output uses real fields and preserves approved layout.
Representative Biz report totals and progress use one source of truth.
Representative QQQAAA event communicates plain Hebrew and retains professional details.

attack_questions: Can any of the 19 requirements still be found missing on the exact public version?
Can a shared control, contact action, gallery or report be broken in a second world, language or viewport?
Can any visible count disagree with its authoritative inventory, period, run or API source?
Can a mobile-to-desktop transition retain an overlay, scroll lock, overlap or hidden action?
Can an operator understand a QQQAAA event and its next action without reading technical identifiers?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public and authenticated admin routes on the published version, including visible interactions, reload and persisted data.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated family matrix plus inspected desktop/mobile screenshots and live flows for every changed shared family.

effectiveness.baseline: The user supplied 19 related deficiencies and explicitly reported repeated regressions across public and admin surfaces.
effectiveness.target: All 19 requirements pass on one published version with zero unresolved critical or high regression findings.
